mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative earnings outlook and causes S&P 500 returns to fall over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 2% from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above the 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a potential shift to tighter monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift to combat inflation causes higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.
